name: Venture firm
blurb: A venture firm's deals, portfolio, people and investment theses, with every signal tied to the beliefs it supports or contradicts.
about: An operating system for a venture firm: one memory its people and its agents share. It holds the companies, people and deals, what was said and written about them, and what the firm concludes from that: insights, patterns and the theses they build into. A CRM has places for contacts, companies and pipeline stages but none for how a view forms. Agents source, brief, chase commitments and draft conclusions on their own branches, and the deal or thesis owner reviews before a merge.
sample: Quito Capital, a fictional AI-infrastructure fund
